map.根据吸水管路与压水管路几何高差、管路损失计算水泵所需总扬程。: Computes total pump head from suction and discharge pipe geometry and losses.
map.水泵扬程 H = 几何扬程 + 损失: Pump head H = geometric head + losses
map.总扬程 H = Hs + Hd + 吸水管路损失 + 压水管路损失 + 压力水头: Total head H = Hs + Hd + suction pipe loss + discharge pipe loss + pressure head difference
map.结果已考虑吸水管路与压水管路流速水头差: The result already accounts for velocity-head difference between suction and discharge pipes
map.按几何高差加管路损失定泵扬程。: Set pump head from geometric head plus pipe losses.
map.变频恒压供水选泵与运行点。: VFD constant-pressure supply: pump and operating-point selection.
map.吸上高度校核汽蚀余量。: Check cavitation margin against suction lift.
map.总扬程 H = 3（吸程）+ 25（几何）+ 5（损失，含裕量）≈ 33 m，据: Total head H = 3 (suction) + 25 (geometry) + 5 (loss, with margin) \u2248 33 m; use this for the pump curve operating point.
map.管路损失从 5 增至 10 m，泵工作点左移流量降，需重选或放大管径。: Pipe loss from 5 to 10 m shifts the operating point left, lowering flow; reselect or enlarge diameter.
map.扬程和流量谁先定？: Which comes first, head or flow?
map.流量由工艺定，扬程由几何高差与阻力定，二者交点即选泵依据。: Flow is set by process; head by geometry and resistance; their intersection is the pump-selection basis.
map.吸上高度加损失不超过允许汽蚀余量，必要时降安装高度或换首级叶轮。: Keep suction lift plus loss within allowable NPSH; if needed, lower installation height or change the first-stage impeller.
